# danduh.me

> Daniel Ostrovsky — AI Architect. Agentic systems, evaluation, governance,
> fine-tuning, MCP, and on-device/browser AI, mostly in JavaScript/TypeScript.

## Courses

### Chrome's Built-in AI — from 0 to superhero
On-device Gemini Nano in the browser: no backend, no API keys, no data leaving
the machine.

- [Introduction](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/introduction): AI in the browser, on-device.
- [Setup & the availability lifecycle](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/setup-and-availability): flags, availability() states, downloads, graceful degradation.
- [The Prompt API (LanguageModel)](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/prompt-api): sessions, prompts, streaming, parameters, tokens.
- [Structured output & tool calling](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/structured-output-and-tools): responseFormat, tools, the intent-loop workaround.
- [Multimodal: image input](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/multimodal): drag/paste, webcam, live loop.
- [The Summarizer API](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/summarizer): key-points, tl;dr, headline, teaser.
- [Translator + Language Detector](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/translator-and-language-detector): detection and translation, on-device.
- [Live voice translation](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/live-voice-translation): Web Speech + Translator.
- [Writer & Rewriter](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/writer-and-rewriter): generate and transform text.
- [The Proofreader API](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/proofreader): grammar/spelling corrections with diffs.
- [Embeddings (SemanticEmbedder)](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/embeddings): vectors, task types, semantic search.
- [WebMCP](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/webmcp): the page as a callable tool surface.
- [Generative UI (MCP Apps)](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/generative-ui): tools that return sandboxed UI.
- [An MCP client in the browser](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/mcp-client): remote MCP over Streamable HTTP.
- [Observability & tracing](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/observability-and-tracing): instrumenting on-device AI.
- [Evaluation](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/evaluation): golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression.
- [Shipping it: the compatibility matrix](https://danduh.me/courses/chrome-built-in-ai/shipping-and-compatibility): versions, flags, fallbacks, checklist.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://danduh.me/blog): essays on AI architecture, agents, MCP, and production AI.
